_about: Readable names for news outlets, by domain. Exa returns only a web address, so Press Pass looks up the outlet's name here (subdomains match too, e.g. markets.ft.com). Any outlet not listed shows its domain instead. Add or edit freely.
_paywalled_about: Outlets behind a paywall. Press Pass never fetches their full text: their summaries come only from the short public excerpt search returns. To summarize one you subscribe to, upload a PDF. Add or remove freely.
_press_release_wires_about: Press-release services. Articles from these sites are never used: Press Pass is for news coverage, not companies' own announcements. News outlets' reports of a product launch are still welcome. Add or remove freely.
